White Q & A|text=Executor Question}} *[[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] |captains=*[[Kendal Ozzel]]{{SWE|characters|admiral-ozzel|Admiral Ozzel}} *[[Firmus Piett]]{{SWE|characters|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett}} |registry= |aliases= }} {{Quote|Aboard the ''Executor'', being ''useful'' is the ''only'' way to survive.|Maximillian Veers|[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 37|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 37]]}} The '''''Executor''''' was an [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] and personal [[flagship]] of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and was the most powerful [[Starship|vessel]] ever created by the [[Galactic Empire]]. Under [[Lord]] Vader's command, the ''Executor'' led the [[Death Squadron]] following the [[Battle of Yavin]] and oversaw the assault on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base|base]] during the [[Battle of Hoth]]. While finally serving as the [[command ship]] during the [[Battle of Endor]] under [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]], the ''Executor'' was destroyed after a wayward rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing starfighter]] piloted by [[Arvel Crynyd]] crashed into its [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], causing the [[Super Star Destroyer]] to lose power and collide with the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]]. ==Description== One of the largest and most powerful [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Starship|vessels]] ever created, the ''Executor'' was 19,000 [[meter]]s long, eclipsing its escorting [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], and boasted more than 5,000 [[turbolaser]]s and [[ion cannon]]s. The center of the arrowhead-shaped [[hull]], constructed of an [[alusteel]] alloy of reinforced [[titanium]], was covered by a [[city]]-like superstructure, while the underside hosted most of the engineering systems. The aft end of the ''Executor'' was marked by a trapezoidal [[Conning tower|command tower]] crowned by two geodesic communication and deflection domes. The thirteen [[Engine|thrusters]] at the bottom end of the hull were responsible for moving the vessel. It was considered the most important ship in the [[Imperial Navy]], and could have feasibly destroyed entire [[fleet]]s unaided. ===Crew=== The ''Executor'' was staffed by a total crew of 280,784, including [[Imperial officer]]s, [[pilot]]s, and enlisted crew. Many of the best and brightest officers of the Imperial Navy were stationed aboard the ''Executor'', because [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] frequent termination of officers offered a fast chance for promotion. There was also a [[throne room]] in one of the highest levels, used at least once by the Emperor himself, which was independent from the rest of the ship and boasted its own [[airlock]]s and [[life support]] systems. At the time of the [[Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel]] was in [[Commanding officer|command]] of the vessel, but he was [[Death|executed]] by Vader, and [[Captain]] [[Firmus Piett]] was promoted to admiral and took command. Piett served as the vessel's last admiral until Endor. Other notable Imperial personnel were based on the ''Executor''. The former[[Darth Vader (2020) 29|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 29]] [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|Naboo Royal Handmaiden]]{{Databank|sabe|Sabé}} and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Commander]][[Darth Vader (2020) 24|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 24]] [[Sabé]] spent some time stationed out of the ''Executor'' and had her own [[Sabé's private quarters|private quarters]] on the ship. The [[assassin]] [[Ochi]] also frequented the vessel. [[Lieutenant]] [[Suba (lieutenant)|Suba]] acted as [[Chief of Security]] aboard the ''Executor''.{{ForceCollection|Lieutenant Suba|star=1}} Droid crew amongst the ''Executor'' included units of a [[Unidentified service droid model|service droid model]][[Darth Vader (2020) 37|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 37]] and a [[Unidentified monster droid model|monster droid model]].[[Darth Vader (2020) 35|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 35]] At least one [[RA-7 protocol droid]] was present aboard the ''Executor''. When Vader took control of the [[droid uprising]], a number of [[B1-series battle droid]]s and [[B2-series super battle droid]]s were brought to the ''Executor'' for repairs. However, those units were quickly corrupted by the [[Scourge]], leading to their destruction at Vader's hands.[[Darth Vader (2020) 38|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 38]] ===Bridge=== [[File:Executorbridge.jpg|left|thumb|198x198px|The ''Executor's'' command bridge]] As in the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I'']]-''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' and [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II'']]-classes,[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]] the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Executor'' featured two elongated pits set below floor level, and a walkway where the superior [[officer]]s stood. One notable difference was that, around 3 ABY,''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}} to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively. the pit consoles were aligned parallel to the walkway, instead of perpendicular. However, by [[4 ABY]], the arrangement of the consoles had been altered. ===Armament=== The ''Executor'' boasted an armament of unimaginable firepower,''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' composed of over 5,000 turbolasers including 750 twin heavy turbolaser batteries, 1000 turret-mounted twin light turbolaser batteries. The ''Executor'' additionally possessed 125 assault [[concussion missile launcher]]s, 100 twin battleship ion cannons, and 250 turret-mounted [[quad laser cannon]]s. ==Service history== ===Origins=== {{Quote|The fleet will be yours. The ''Executor'' will be yours.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Vader|[[Darth Vader (2015) 25|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 25]]}} [[File:ExecutorAboveKuat-2015DarthVader20.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The ''Executor'' in construction above Kuat.]] Built by [[Kuat Drive Yards]], the ''Executor'' was part of a [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|class]] of [[Star Destroyer]]s of the same name, which were the fruit of a project the [[Sith Lord]] Darth Vader had been pushing for.''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'' The ''Executor'' was intended to take the place of the [[Liberty's Misrule|''Annihilator'']] as the [[flagship]] of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)|Supreme Commander]], [[Grand General]] [[Cassio Tagge]], and therefore assume the position of the greatest starship in the entire Imperial Fleet. By the aftermath of the [[Shu-Torun War]], the [[Super Star Destroyer]] was entering the final stages of its construction at the [[orbit]]al [[Kuat shipyards|shipyards]] of [[Kuat]].[[Darth Vader (2015) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 20]] When the rogue [[Doctor]] [[Cylo]] [[Cylo Hijacking|attempted]] to take over the starship and initiate a coup against [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]], he was stopped by Lord Vader. As a reward, the [[Emperor]] gifted his [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] the ''Executor'' and its fleet. Tagge tried to reason with Vader, who now possessed more authority than him, but Vader did not relent. The [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] quickly [[Force choke]]d the Grand General to death for his blunders, and then asked Admiral Kendal Ozzel when the ship would be ready. Ozzel replied it would be about a [[Standard month|month]] before the ship would be launched due to damages from Cylo's takeover, but Vader gave him two [[Standard week|weeks]]. When the officer began to protest this, the Dark Lord threatened his subordinate by saying he sounded a lot like the late Grand General. Ozzel looked at the now-dead Tagge, and then assured Vader the ship would be ready. Vader looked out at [[Realspace|space]], and used [[the Force]] to briefly connect with his son, [[Luke Skywalker]]. The ''Executor'' became the [[command ship]] of the [[Death Squadron]], the fleet of [[capital ship]]s assigned to [[Darth]] Vader, and also continued to be commanded by Kendal Ozzel, whom Vader began to become increasingly annoyed at. The ship replaced the ''[[Devastator]]'' as the Sith Lord's flagship,{{InsiderCite|issue1=149|issue2=150|Blade Squadron (short story)}} and many of the [[stormtrooper]]s who served aboard the vessel were selected due to their excellent performance in the [[Imperial Academy]].[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] Due to the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin]], that saw the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroy the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]], the Dark Lord and his [[flotilla]] were tasked with finding the Rebels' base.At some point after the ''Executor'' was given to Vader, it was specially modified to have a [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber|meditation chamber]], similar to the one at [[Fortress Vader|his abode]] on [[Mustafar]]. ===Mako-Ta Space Docks=== {{Quote|I haven't seen anything that big since the Death Star. Vader. It has to be.|Luke Skywalker|[[Star Wars (2015) 50|''Star Wars'' (2015) 50]]}}
[[File:AssaultOnMakoTaBegins-2015StarWars50.jpg|thumb|230px|The ''Executor'' arrives at Mako-Ta]]
After [[Queen]] [[Trios]] contacted Lord Vader, revealing the location of the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] at the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]],[[Star Wars (2015) 49|''Star Wars'' (2015) 49]] the ''Executor'', along with the rest of Death [[Squadron]], arrived at the rebel [[space station]], initiating an [[Battle of Mako-Ta|attack]] on the fleet. From the ''Executor'', the Dark Lord commanded the attack, ordering the destruction of the nearest [[cruiser]], ''[[Yavin's Hope]]''. When the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', piloted by the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], arrived at Mako-Ta and attempted to use a rebel proximity signal to open the locked [[Starfighter|fighter]] [[Hangar|bay]] doors, Vader left his flagship to pursue them in [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced|his TIE Advanced]].[[Star Wars (2015) 51|''Star Wars'' (2015) 51]] Ozzel continue to command the attack from the ''Executor'', ordering several more cruisers to be destroyed. Vader's attempt to stop Solo from opening the bay doors of Dodonna's flagship, the [[Republic (MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser)|''Republic'']], failed, and a squadron of [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] lead by Luke Skywalker entered the battle, forming [[Rogue Squadron]].[[Star Wars (2015) 52|''Star Wars'' (2015) 52]] The rebels on Mako-Ta continued to search Trios' files for a way to reactivate their fleet, and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] learned that the override code was located aboard the ''Executor''. In order to board the flagship, [[Princess]] Organa used the [[transponder code]]s of the [[Shu-Torun]] [[Monarchy|monarch's]] [[Trios' ship|ship]] to pose as the [[Monarch of Shu-Torun|queen]], taking a team of [[General]] [[Davits Draven]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces|forces]] with her. They were cleared to land, and managed to sneak out of the ship, killing the Imperial officer who had come to greet them. As Draven ordered his [[Alliance Military|forces]] out of Trios' ship, he noticed Vader's [[TIE Advanced x1|TIE Advanced]] heading towards them, alerting Organa. The rebels managed to escape, but the Dark Lord landed in the docking bay and drew [[Darth Vader's lightsaber|his lightsaber]], aware of their presence.[[Star Wars (2015) 53|''Star Wars'' (2015) 53]] The rebels succeeded in retrieving the override codes and made it to a hangar where a single TIE fighter was docked. After some discussion they agreed to have Leia take it back to Dodonna's flagship while Draven would lead the rearguard to delay Vader. This succeeded and the Princess escaped however the General and the rearguard were all killed by the Dark Lord. The ''Republic'' regained power and successfully fled the battle.[[Star Wars (2015) 54|''Star Wars'' (2015) 54]] As Vader and Ozzel watched the remaining rebel ships get destroyed, Dodonna's ship returned. It opened fire on the ''Executor'', which led to the Imperials focusing on that ship. This was a distraction which allowed Han and Leia to take transports to the remaining cruisers to give them the codes to escape. The remained rebel vessels fled except the ''Republic'' as it had been too badly damaged and was finished off by the Imperials.[[Star Wars (2015) 55|''Star Wars'' (2015) 55]] ===Battle of Hoth=== {{Quote|Move the ship out of the asteroid field, so we can send a clear transmission.|Darth Vader|}} [[File:Executor-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Executor'' exited the Hoth asteroid belt for clear communication with the Emperor.]] In 3 ABY, an [[XJ9-CS14|Imperial probe droid]] located the Rebel hideout, [[Echo Base]], on the frozen [[planet]] of [[Hoth]] while the ''Executor'' and its fellow ships were in the [[Juris sector]].''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' Although Ozzel disagreed with Vader, Vader sensed they found the Rebels and commanded him to move the armada to the [[Hoth system]]. However, the Admiral brought their fleet out of [[hyperspace]] too close to the [[Star system|system]], which allowed the Rebels to raise their defensive base shields, forcing the Empire to initiate a ground assault. Ozzel was subsequently killed by Vader for his failure, and Captain Firmus Piett was promoted to serve as Ozzel's successor. [[File:Executor_side_-_ESB.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' escapes from the ''Executor''.]] As the Empire evicted the Rebels from Hoth's surface, the ''Executor'', accompanied by several ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers, pursued the fleeing ''Millennium Falcon'', into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]] adjacent to the [[Anoat system]]. Lord Vader eventually ordered the ''Executor'' to abandon the pursuit and get clear of the [[asteroid field]], in order for him to communicate with Emperor Palpatine without disruptions. He later directed the ship to the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]], where he intended to trap the fugitives headed there aboard the ''Falcon'' in order to lure out his son, Luke Skywalker. ===The War of the Bounty Hunters=== {{Quote|Our fighters have engaged the Hutt attackers, ''Admiral Piett''.|An [[Imperial officer]] to [[Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]] on the status of the ''Executor''{{'s}} fighters|[[War of the Bounty Hunters 5|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 5]]}} After Lord Vader took Captain Solo, frozen in [[carbonite]], from the [[Crimson Dawn]] [[Auction for Han Solo|auction]] on [[Jekara]], he lured in Luke Skywalker and engaged in a dogfight. Simultaneously, General [[Hurst Romodi]]'s [[ST-718|shuttle]] was immobilized during the transportation of carbon-encased smuggler to the ''Executor''. The [[bounty hunter]]s [[Beilert Valance]] and [[Boba Fett]], aboard the ''[[Slave I]]'', moved in to retrieve Solo at the same time as [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], Leia Organa, and the rest of the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Meanwhile, the [[Hutt Clan]] was beckoned by Crimson Dawn into [[Attack on the Executor|attacking]] the ''Executor'', an overt affront to the Empire. Eventually, Fett acquired Solo, Valance was left for dead, and Vader slaughtered the treacherous [[Bokku]] and his fellow [[Hutt]] companions. ===Battle of Endor=== {{Quote|We've got to give those fighters more time. Concentrate all fire on that Super Star Destroyer!|Admiral Gial Ackbar, issuing the destruction of ''Executor''|}} [[File:HesGoodButNotTHATGood-ROTJHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The second Death Star was defended by the ''Executor'' and a fleet of Imperial Star Destroyers in the Battle of Endor.]] In 4 ABY, the ''Executor'', still commanded by Piett, served as the flagship for an Imperial fleet of Star Destroyers that assembled at the remote [[forest]] [[moon]] of [[Endor]], where the Empire's new superweapon, the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] was under construction. The ''Executor'' stood guard over Endor, taking clearance requests from any starship that entered the system.{{InsiderCite|220|A Certain Point of View}} When the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Tydirium]]'' arrived in the system, the ''Executor'' reached out for its code clearance, to which it received an older but still valid code. Just as Piett was going to allow the shuttle a chance to pass, Vader asked for more information on its destination after sensing there was more to the ship; the shuttle had actually been stolen by the Rebel Alliance and was transporting a [[Endor strike team|strike team]], among its members Skywalker, to the surface. While Piett was willing to hold the ''Tydirium'', Vader led the ship pass to deal with the matter personally. When a Rebel fleet arrived into the system in an attempt to destroy the incomplete [[battle station]], initiating the [[Battle of Endor]], the ''Executor'' and the fleet moved into position to prevent the Rebels from retreating. Admiral Piett, however, did not attack the Rebels, as Emperor Palpatine wanted to demonstrate the destructive power of the [[Death Star]]'s [[superlaser]] against the cornered Rebel [[capital]] ships. Fleeing the Death Star's firepower, the Rebels engaged Piett's Star Destroyers at close range while their [[Endor strike team|ground assault team]] destroyed the [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] protecting the superweapon, allowing the Rebel fighters to fly into its superstructure. The Alliance Fleet [[Supreme fleet commander|Supreme Commander]], Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]], wishing to buy more [[time]] for the fighters to accomplish their mission, ordered a concentrated barrage against the ''Executor''. As the Alliance [[warship]]s focused their fire on the Super Star Destroyer, two [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s strafed the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge [[deflector shield]]s, bringing them down. In response, Piett ordered the forward batteries to intensify their firepower to prevent anything from penetrating the window of opportunity. [[File:CrashOfTheExecutor-RotJ40-Prouse.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Executor'' was destroyed when it crashed into the Death Star.]] Aware that the ''Executor'' would become the fulcrum of not only the battle but also the balance of power in the entire [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]], [[Vice Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]] moved her ship, the [[Vigilance (Imperial-class)|''Vigilance'']] to flank position on the ''Executor'' to try and defend it.{{StoryCite|story=The Levers of Power|book=The Rise of the Empire}} However, Rebel [[Green Leader]] [[Arvel Crynyd]], with his [[A-wing starfighter]] badly damaged by fire from the ''Executor'', managed to retain just enough control of his stricken ship to send it towards the Imperial vessel's unshielded bridge. Seeing the threat, Admiral Piett once again shouted to intensify the forward batteries, but, as Commander [[Gherant]] realized, it was too late; the Rebel fighter crashed into the ''Executor'' command tower. As explosions engulfed the bridge, the massive ship listed to port and plunged towards the Death Star's surface, exploding upon impact. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Piett, you fool.|Admiral [[Garrick Versio]], after witnessing the ''Executor''{{'s}} destruction|''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''}} With the destruction of the ''Executor'', many of the best and most capable officers of the Imperial Navy died along with the over 300,000 onboard. The destruction of the ''Executor'' ended any hope for the Imperials to win the Battle of Endor, which resulted in a crushing defeat for the Galactic Empire. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We built Vader's six-foot-long ship, which had about 150,000 lights in it. George wanted the ship to play a much bigger role in the film, which justified spending more money on it—George wanted it huge.|[[Lorne Peterson]]|''[[The Moviemaking Magic of Star Wars: Ships & Battles]]''}} When asked how to officially pronounce "Executor," [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] was unable to give a final answer other than his personal preference.{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1741244307716325861|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-12-30|quote=I cannot give you a final answer. I can tell you that I say it the first way, but that's just me. {{C|In response to: "Okay @pabl0hidalgo I need a final answer: Is the Executor pronounced ig-ZEK-yuh-ter or EK-si-kyoo-ter?"}}|archiveurl=https://archive.is/fbNqP}} The non-[[canon]] video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' features the ''Executor'', which General [[Rothlan]] attempts to defend against the player should they attack.''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'' In ''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'', [[Tom Angleberger]]'s retelling of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the Super Star Destroyer present at the battle of Endor was mistakenly referred to as "the ''Eclipse'', the Emperor's own Super Star Destroyer."''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' In Angleberger's manuscript, that mistake had been caught and fixed by Hidalgo,{{Twitter|OrigamiYoda|status/651442939906932736|[[Tom Angleberger]]|quote=@LordZack01 @Coopx30 @LelalMekha in this picture you can see that Pablo caught the mistake and fixed it: http://ow.ly/i/dwrKu|archivedate=20170216105023}} who even specifically added that "There's only one Super Star Destroyer [at Endor], and it's the ''Executor''."{{Twitter|OrigamiYoda|status/651441665950007296|[[Tom Angleberger]]|quote=@LordZack01 @Coopx30 @LelalMekha @wookieepedia Are you guys ready for this? Here's Pablo's note on my manuscript: http://ow.ly/i/dwr9R|archivedate=20160517113243}} Despite Hidalgo's correction, the mistake still appeared in the released version of the story. ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' and ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' state that the ''Executor'' was the first of its class; however, this is contradicted by other sources, and this article assumes ''On the Front Lines'' and ''Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition'' are in error. ==Appearances== {{ScrollBox| {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Executor}} *''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''
